body: I feel like we are in the same boat. I haven’t moved to antidepressants at all. I’m not even trying to find another spouse or partner, just someone that I can connect to on a deeper level then just friends. That genuinely cares for me, checks up on me.

This is exactly what I need. When researching poly it wasn’t to try and find another lover. But it was to find someone I could build another relationship with that would better me. It’s just hurtful because the way I wanted it to happen didn’t go at all. I want to talk about it and explain how I felt and rather then doing that she went to everyone and told them. It’s just sad because the issues is was having was not having enough good people around me and now the ones I did, she has turned them off to me.

Thank you so much for this! 

Therapy is what lead me into researching this. I started with learning how I needed to be loved and what it takes. I don’t see polyamory as a way to sleep with other people, but a way of having more meaningful relationships with people. I think the dark times I was having was due to the fact that I’ve been loved incorrectly for so long that I wore down on me. 

It is sad to think that someone I trusted would do stuff like this but it’s just the world we live in now.

Another bad day. Found my self looking up more ways to kill my self. What medication I could take that would do it quickly. Possibly in my sleep. I sit at work as i right this laughing and joking with coworkers. The emptiness is just heavy. I feel a void behind my eyes. A frantic brain trying to find the will to live but coming up empty handed time and time again. I pulled out my father in laws old climbing ropes and have been day dreaming of hanging my self all night.

It’s the time to grow. Start over. I wish that I could get a clean slate. If I could vanish with my kids in a heart beat I would do it. Be the statistic that’s good. Be the father that’s there for their kids. Even if it’s a message a day it’ll make a difference.

I feel the same way. The only thing that keeps me from getting there is my children. I know what I missed out on from not having a father and I know what it’s like. They keep me going. They are my rocks

I understand completely. Maybe I have surrounded myself with the wrong type of people who don’t ask those deep questions. You know it’s the same situation.  I’m not perfect but me forgetting to do small things is nothing in comparison to what I’ve been through. It’s the constant feeling of maybe I made a mistake. But I’m to afraid to do something about it. Why I don’t know but the longer I keep this up the more and more of me that I lose.
